```python
is_packed_tree(tree: object) -> bool
```

Part of [`evoxc_hf.pack`](/api/evoxc-hf/pack/)

Whether a params tree (mapping or key iterable) uses packed input names.

Used only for diagnostics: `evoxc_hf.run` and `evoxc_hf.predict` name
the `pack_weights` remedy instead of surfacing a bare evoxc pytree error when
a caller mixes the two tree shapes.

## Parameters

- `tree` · `object` — a params mapping, or an iterable of keys.

## Returns

- `bool` — `True` when the tree is non-empty and every key starts with `PACKED_PREFIX`.
